title: Sample Worksheet (형식 예시)
note: 형식 확인용 예시 파일입니다. 실제 기사 내용이 아닙니다.

paragraphs: This file shows the shape of a worksheet, not a real news article. Replace every sentence here with the passage you want your students to read.
Keep each paragraph in its own string. The renderer lays them out for A4 paper and keeps the spacing even, so you do not have to think about page layout at all.
Three PDFs come out of this one file: the reading passage, the student worksheet, and the answer key.

questions.q: How many PDFs does one JSON file produce?
What should you do with the sentences in this sample?
questions.answer: Replace them with the real article you want students to read.

writing.prompt: Write two sentences about a topic you would like to read about in English.
writing.sample: 학생마다 답이 다릅니다. 두 문장을 완성했는지, 주제가 분명한지 확인해 주세요.
